topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: Well, isn't this just perfect? Of course, the flight has to be delayed, and of course, it had to be today. Now, I'll manage to miss that event, the one that was crucial, the one I couldn't afford to skip. Hours wasted, plans shattered, all because some faceless corporation decided that keeping to schedule is optional. They'll offer their generic apologies, the ones that mean nothing, the ones that don't fix anything. I'm stuck here, in this terminal, surrounded by the oblivious or the indifferent. What a brilliant way to spend my day, isn’t it?
